parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Luc is painting the doors in his house.
He uses of a tin of paint for each door.
Work out the least number of tins of paint Luc needs to paint 7 doors.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Jan buys tins of paint for $17.16 each.
He sells the paint at a profit of 25%.
For how much does Jan sell each tin of paint?

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The cost of $17.16 for each tin of paint is 4% more than the cost in the previous year.
Work out the cost of each tin of paint in the previous year.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
In America a tin of paint costs $17.16 .
In Italy the same tin of paint costs €13.32 .
The exchange rate is $1 = €0.72 .
Calculate, in dollars, the difference in the cost of the tin of paint.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Paint is sold in cylindrical tins of height 11 cm.
Each tin holds 750 ml of paint.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Write 750 ml in cm .

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Calculate the radius of the tin.
Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
A mathematically similar tin has a height of 22 cm.
How many litres of paint does this tin hold?

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
The mass of a tin of paint is 890 grams, correct to the nearest 10 grams.
Work out the upper bound of the total mass of 10 tins of paint.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
The probability that a tin of paint is dented is 0.07 .
Out of 3000 tins of paint, how many would you expect to be dented?

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
Tins of paint are filled at the rate of 2 m per minute.
How many 750 ml tins of paint can be filled in 1 hour?
